title: Separate triple compactification normal forms for finite forward products
statement:
Use the finite coefficient field and ring $k,A=A_{E,n}$ of [def-pur-conventions]. All schemes are separated finite-type $k$-schemes, and all maps are separated of finite type [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Work in the ordinary unbounded constant-$A$ module derived categories on small pro-etale sites, with the canonical pullbacks $Lu^*$, direct images $Ru_*$, adjunctions $Lu^*\dashv Ru_*$, derived tensor and signed symmetry $\sigma$ [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Write $P\boxtimes Q=L\pi_1^*P\otimes_A^LL\pi_2^*Q$ on a fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product], and insert the canonical pullback, tensor and direct-image composition comparisons.
For $u:U\to B$, $v:V\to B$ with product projections $r,t$ and $w=ur=vt$, define $\Xi_{u,v}(P,Q)$ to be the forward product, with all arrows specified by [def-exchange-projection, thm-sf-comp-composition]:
$$\alpha_{v,t}Rv_!\bigl(\operatorname{PF}_{t,Lr^*P,Q}(\operatorname{Ex}_{!,u,v,P}\otimes1_Q)\bigr)Rv_!(\sigma_{Q,Lv^*Ru_!P})\operatorname{PF}_{v,Q,Ru_!P}\sigma_{Ru_!P,Rv_!Q}.$$
Its source is $Ru_!P\otimes Rv_!Q$ and target $Rw_!(P\boxtimes Q)$. For proper $u,v$, write $\Omega_{u,v}$ for the ordinary direct-image word obtained by replacing $R(-)_!$, $\operatorname{Ex}_!$, $\operatorname{PF}$ and $\alpha$ by $R(-)_*$, $\operatorname{Ex}_*$, $\pi$ and the inverse ordinary direct-image compositor, respectively [lem-pur-finite-proper-product-transpose].
Let $f_i:X_i\to B$ and $M_i\in D^+(X_{i,\mathrm{proet}},A)$, $i=1,2,3$, have etale-origin witnesses [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]. Choose compactifications $f_i=a_i j_i$ with $j_i:X_i\hookrightarrow\bar X_i$ open and $a_i:\bar X_i\to B$ proper [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Put $H_i=j_{i!}M_i$, $P=X_1\times_BX_2\times_BX_3$, $\bar P=\bar X_1\times_B\bar X_2\times_B\bar X_3$, $u=j_1\times_Bj_2\times_Bj_3$, $c:\bar P\to B$, and $h:P\to B$. Assume that every tensor object in the binary and iterated forward words below is bounded below and has an etale-origin witness. Use the normalized compactification comparisons [prop-compactification-coherence-detailed].
For any triple $(b_i,N_i)$ let
$$\Theta_L(\Xi;b,N)=\Xi_{b_{12},b_3}(N_1\boxtimes N_2,N_3)(\Xi_{b_1,b_2}(N_1,N_2)\otimes1),$$
$$\Theta_R(\Xi;b,N)=\Xi_{b_1,b_{23}}(N_1,N_2\boxtimes N_3)(1\otimes\Xi_{b_2,b_3}(N_2,N_3)),$$
where $b_{ij}$ is the structure map of the corresponding binary fibre product. Define $\Theta_L(\Omega;a,H)$ and $\Theta_R(\Omega;a,H)$ by these same formulas with the ordinary word $\Omega$.
For two opens let $e_{j,k}$ be the normalized open external-tensor isomorphism of [lem-pur-finite-open-product-swap]. Set
$$e_L=e_{j_1\times j_2,j_3}(e_{j_1,j_2}\boxtimes1),\qquad e_R=e_{j_1,j_2\times j_3}(1\boxtimes e_{j_2,j_3}),$$
using the extension-by-zero compositors. These are isomorphisms from $H_1\boxtimes H_2\boxtimes H_3$ to $u_!(M_1\boxtimes M_2\boxtimes M_3)$ whose restrictions along $u$ are the identity. Under $Rh_!\cong Rc_*u_!$ the two separate identities hold:
$$\Theta_L(\Xi;f,M)=Rc_*(e_L)\Theta_L(\Omega;a,H),\qquad\Theta_R(\Xi;f,M)=Rc_*(e_R)\Theta_R(\Omega;a,H).$$
The identities respect changes of all chosen compactifications through their normalized refinement comparisons. No invertibility of projection or exchange, finite Tor amplitude, exceptional adjoint, duality axiom or abstract six-functor datum is an input.

source.place: Single proof paragraph, clause (ii) with the sentence 'after reduction to proper f,g by the independence of the compactification': each triple iterate reduced to the product compactification; agent-formulated concrete finite-coefficient refinement, with the ordinary maps defined by counits and normalized open extension; no abstract datum is assumed.

proof.text: Apply the four binary compactification identities, choosing the intermediate origin antecedents supplied by the domain hypotheses. Isomorphism of eL and eR follows from the binary isomorphisms and preservation by functors. Binary restriction pasting gives both triple unit equations. For each bracketing, substitute the inner identity into the outer identity, move the inner open map across the ordinary product by its naturality square, and combine direct-image maps by functoriality. The private categorical substitution lemmas explicitly verify the two different tensor-variable calculations. All endpoint compactifications remain independent, so this proves the change clause in the same equalities.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q39-cc41ba72c (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item in full (statement and 5 steps), every cited statement, the parent step and the sources: blueprint lem-sf-kunneth-coherence clause (ii) in latest and main-20261015, and Stacks 01JR, 01W3 and 01W4. The statement is unchanged; its Xi and Omega match the T and Omega of lem-pur-finite-product-compactification word for word. Step 1 cites the open-fibre-product leaf (base open B) and proper composition and base change, so j_ij is open and a_ij is proper. Step 2 is correct: the swap node holds on arbitrary unbounded inputs and gives isomorphisms restricting to 1. Steps 3 and 4 apply the binary node twice; the inner target and outer source use the same normalized (j12,a12) comparison, and the naturality square holds because Ex_*, pi and sigma are natural and kappa is natural; I re-derived both calculations. The binary node's e and the swap node's e are the same map: both are the unique isomorphism into u_!D restricting to 1, by u_! -| u^*. Step 5 uses the binary node's freedom to choose any compactifications, plus comp-composition choice-independence and the refinement cocycle; this is correct. The witness hypothesis on every tensor covers D12 and D23, and no Tor-amplitude or abstract-datum assumption is made. All proof_deps lie on the route of sk-prop-an, so the declared tool use of lem-weil-derived-direct-image-composition is unneeded but harmless. There is no cycle, no new node, and no duplicate: lem-sf-triple-compactification-normal-form needs a six-functor datum and D^b_ctf inputs. The live node is still unsplit. Batch-5: lem-trf-proetale-composition-tower-normalization, reached through lem-pur-product-exchange-counit-coordinates, is a general formula for the composition map alpha on a compactification tower. Neither the trace formula nor Poincare duality gives it and it is not a step of their proofs, so it is not a return ground. Edge cases checked: identity opens, an empty factor, proper f_i and zero inputs.
